summary: AtomVecKokkos_PackBorderVel drops the non-deform-group velocity branch, so with fix deform + remap v the buffer is short by 3 doubles for every atom outside the deform group and every field packed after v lands at the wrong offset.
failure_scenario: atom_style sphere/kk (or any kk style) + 'fix deform ... remap v' + 'comm_modify vel yes' on a GPU build (forward/exchange comm on device): border atoms not in the deform group get an uninitialized/garbage ghost velocity and every following border-vel field (radius, rmass, omega, q, molecule, mu, angmom, DPD energies) is read from the wrong buffer slot -> wrong forces/energies, potentially NaN.
suggested_fix: Add the missing else branch that writes _v(j,0..2) unshifted (and advances m) when the atom is not in the deform group, exactly as src/atom_vec.cpp:955-959 does.

summary: AtomVecKokkos_PackCommVel never initializes its _mu and _sp views, yet operator() reads them when datamask_comm_vel carries MU_MASK/SP_MASK (atom_style dipole/kk, spin/kk), dereferencing a default-constructed (null) Kokkos view.
failure_scenario: 'atom_style dipole/kk' with 'comm_modify vel yes' on a GPU build -> pack_comm_vel_kokkos launches a kernel that reads _mu(j,0) from an unallocated view: segfault/illegal memory access (or silent garbage dipoles on ghosts with bounds checking off).
suggested_fix: Add _mu(atomKK->k_mu.view<DeviceType>()) and _sp(atomKK->k_sp.view<DeviceType>()) to the AtomVecKokkos_PackCommVel initializer list, in member-declaration order.

summary: unpack_border_vel_kokkos picks the 'x/tag/type/mask/v only' functor based on ncomm_vel instead of nborder_vel, so for atom_style charge/bond/angle/molecular/full the q and molecule values that pack_border_vel_kokkos wrote are never unpacked into ghost atoms.
failure_scenario: 'atom_style full/kk' + 'comm_modify vel yes' (e.g. with fix rigid or a granular/SPH pair style) on a GPU build: every ghost atom keeps a stale or uninitialized charge and molecule ID after each reneighboring -> wrong Coulomb forces and wrong special-bond/molecule-ID-based exclusions.
suggested_fix: Branch on `!nborder_vel` (not `!ncomm_vel`) in unpack_border_vel_kokkos, or give AtomVecKokkos_PackBorderVel the same DEFAULT template parameter so packer and unpacker are selected by the same predicate.

summary: field2size("num_improper") sizes the improper block with atom->dihedral_per_atom instead of atom->improper_per_atom, so size_exchange is too small whenever a system has more impropers per atom than dihedrals per atom, and pack_exchange writes past the end of its buffer row.
failure_scenario: atom_style full/kk or molecular/kk for a molecule with e.g. improper_per_atom=6 and dihedral_per_atom=4: pack_exchange_kokkos writes 10 doubles past the row for every migrating atom, corrupting the next atom's exchange record (and the last row overruns the allocation) -> lost/garbled bonded topology or a crash during atom migration.

summary: None of the forward-comm functors handle RADIUS_MASK/RMASS_MASK, so 'atom_style sphere/kk 1' (dynamic radii) silently never forward-communicates radius and rmass to ghost atoms even though size_forward reserves room for them.
failure_scenario: 'atom_style sphere/kk 1' with 'fix adapt ... diameter' on a GPU build: ghost particles keep their radius and rmass from the last borders() call, so pair granular/gran overlap distances and masses are wrong for every ghost contact -> wrong forces, silently.
suggested_fix: Add `if (_datamask & RADIUS_MASK) ...` and `if (_datamask & RMASS_MASK) ...` blocks (in the order used by pack_border) to AtomVecKokkos_PackComm, UnpackComm, PackCommSelf, PackCommSelfFused, PackCommVel and UnpackCommVel, or reject radvary in AtomVecSphereKokkos.

summary: The ellipsoid bonus forward-comm functors always build their buffer view with a row stride of size_forward, but when called from pack_comm_vel_kokkos/unpack_comm_vel_kokkos the buffer stride is size_forward+size_velocity and the offset already includes size_velocity, so the quaternions are written into and read from the wrong buffer rows.
failure_scenario: 'atom_style ellipsoid/kk' with 'comm_modify vel yes' on a GPU build: the ghost quaternions are garbage and the neighbouring atom's communicated x/v are overwritten -> completely wrong aspherical forces, likely blow-up.
suggested_fix: Pass the vel_flag (or the already-computed stride) into the bonus functors and build the buffer view with elements = size_forward + (vel_flag ? size_velocity : 0), matching AtomVecKokkos_PackCommVel.

summary: The Device branch of AtomVecMolecularKokkos::sync_pinned omits k_dihedral_atom4, so that array is never staged to the device while its dual-view sync flag is cleared by the surrounding transfers.
failure_scenario: Any future/existing caller of atomKK->sync_pinned(Device, DIHEDRAL_MASK) after the host modified the topology (data file read, fix bond/react, molecule template insertion) leaves dihedral_atom4 stale on the device -> the 4th atom of every dihedral is wrong on the GPU.  Currently latent: the three call sites (verlet_kokkos.cpp:448, third_order_kokkos.cpp:230, dynamical_matrix_kokkos.cpp:230) all pass Host/HostKK.
suggested_fix: Add the missing k_dihedral_atom4 need_sync_device()/perform_pinned_copy_transform pair to the Device branch.

summary: The Device branch of AtomVecFullKokkos::sync_pinned omits k_dihedral_atom4 (same copy-paste defect as the molecular style).
failure_scenario: Same as the molecular case: a Device-space pinned sync of DIHEDRAL_MASK leaves dihedral_atom4 stale on the GPU for atom_style full/kk.
suggested_fix: Add the missing k_dihedral_atom4 entry to the Device branch.

summary: AtomVecKokkos::~AtomVecKokkos never frees the pinned staging buffer allocated by perform_pinned_copy/perform_pinned_copy_transform, leaking it for the lifetime of the process.
failure_scenario: An input script that changes atom_style (or any run that constructs and destroys several LAMMPS instances / uses the library interface repeatedly) leaks nmax*3*sizeof(double) of page-locked host memory per atom_vec instance; pinned memory is a scarce resource and exhausting it makes further CUDA/HIP allocations fail.
suggested_fix: In ~AtomVecKokkos, `if (buffer) Kokkos::kokkos_free<LMPPinnedHostType>(buffer);` (guarded by the same #ifdef LMP_KOKKOS_GPU as the allocation) and reset buffer/buffer_size.

summary: Source file contains a non-ASCII character (U+2019 RIGHT SINGLE QUOTATION MARK) in a comment, violating the project's 7-bit US-ASCII rule and failing the style CI check.
failure_scenario: `cd src && make check` / the style-check.yml GitHub workflow fails on this file before the release.
suggested_fix: Replace the typographic apostrophe with a plain ASCII apostrophe (J's).

summary: AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos silently accepts the 'superellipsoid' sub-style argument but is hard-wired to the plain-ellipsoid bonus layout and never allocates atom->radius, so ellipsoid/kk superellipsoid is broken rather than rejected.
evidence: src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_ellipsoid_kokkos.cpp:39 hard-codes `size_exchange_bonus = 8;` and the pack/unpack bonus functors move exactly shape[3]+quat[4] (lines 483-489, 557-563, 655-661), matching src/atom_vec_ellipsoid.cpp:46-48 size_border_bonus/size_restart_bonus_one = 8.  AtomVecEllipsoid::process_args (src/atom_vec_ellipsoid.cpp:1095-1114) raises those to 13, switches the bonus storage to bonus_super, and appends "radius" to fields_grow/copy/border/border_vel/exchange/restart/create.  AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos does not override process_args, and its grow() (lines 87-99) grows tag,type,mask,image,x,v,f,rmass,angmom,torque,ellipsoid - never atomKK->k_radius - while set_atom_masks() will put RADIUS_MASK into datamask_border, so AtomVecKokkos_PackBorder (atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:1534-1535) reads _radius(j) from an unallocated view.
failure_scenario: 'atom_style ellipsoid/kk superellipsoid' -> null/empty radius view dereferenced during the first borders() call, and blockiness parameters are never communicated -> crash or silently wrong superquadric shapes.
suggested_fix: Override process_args in AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos to error out on 'superellipsoid' (or implement it: grow k_radius, use the 13-wide bonus layout and the Bonus_Super struct).

summary: AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos_PackExchangeBonus reads the bonus array through _bonus while concurrently writing the same memory through the _bonusw alias in the same parallel_for, so a compacted bonus entry can be read after another thread has overwritten it.
evidence:
src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_ellipsoid_kokkos.cpp:631-634 aliases the same DualView twice:
      _bonus(bonus.template view<DeviceType>()),
      ...
      _bonusw(bonus.template view<DeviceType>()),
and operator() at lines 655-677 first reads `_bonus(j).shape[0] ... _bonus(j).quat[3]` for j = _ellipsoid[i] and then writes
        _ellipsoidw[_bonus[j_bonus].ilocal] = i_bonus;
        _bonusw[i_bonus] = _bonus[j_bonus];
Nothing orders these across threads.  The authors were aware of the hazard - lines 756-757 say 'must backfill ellipsoid after pack exchange bonus in a separate functor to prevent race conditions' - but the bonus compaction itself was left in the packing kernel.
failure_scenario: Two atoms leaving the sub-domain in the same exchange whose copylist_bonus tail entry for one is the i_bonus slot of the other: the second thread reads a slot the first has already overwritten -> the ellipsoid that stays behind gets the wrong shape/quaternion.  Requires a specific ordering, so it is intermittent.
suggested_fix: Move the bonus compaction (the `_bonusw[i_bonus] = _bonus[j_bonus]` block) into its own parallel_for after the packing kernel, exactly as was done for AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos_BackfillEllipsoid, or verify and document that copylist_bonus can never alias a sent i_bonus.

summary: The ellipsoid border-bonus functors index the communication buffer with the raw view's own extent(1) instead of the packing stride size_border(+size_velocity), which disagrees with AtomVecKokkos_UnpackBorderVel when the receive buffer was allocated with the narrower shape.
failure_scenario: 'atom_style ellipsoid/kk' + 'comm_modify vel yes' with more than one MPI rank: unpack_border_bonus_kokkos reads the bonus flag/shape/quat at row-stride 15 from a buffer that unpack_border_vel_kokkos treated as row-stride 21 -> ghost ellipsoid shapes and orientations come from the wrong atom.
suggested_fix: Build an explicit unmanaged view with elements = size_border + (vel_flag ? size_velocity : 0) inside the bonus border functors (and fix grow_recv_kokkos to allocate the wider row when ghost_velocity is set).

summary: AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos::sort_kokkos applies the per-atom bin permutation to the bonus array, which is indexed by ellipsoid[i] rather than by atom index, and it uses the d_bonus member that is never assigned anywhere.
failure_scenario: If the bonus guard in AtomKokkos::sort is ever relaxed, an on-device atom sort scrambles shapes/quaternions and leaves stale bonus.ilocal values -> silently wrong aspherical dynamics.
suggested_fix: Remove the `Sorter.sort(..., d_bonus)` call (and the unused d_bonus/h_bonus members), or implement a proper bonus re-index + ilocal fixup before enabling device sorting for bonus styles.

summary: perform_pinned_copy separates two Kokkos::deep_copy statements with a comma operator instead of a semicolon in both branches.
evidence:
src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_kokkos.h:275-276 and 280-281:
      Kokkos::deep_copy(LMPHostType(),tmp_view,src.view_host()),
      Kokkos::deep_copy(LMPHostType(),src.view_device(),tmp_view);
Both calls execute in order so behaviour is currently correct, but the comma makes the pair a single expression statement and will silently swallow the second call if the first is ever wrapped in a conditional.
failure_scenario: No current misbehaviour; a maintenance hazard and a compiler-warning source (-Wcomma).
suggested_fix: Replace the trailing commas with semicolons.

summary: set_atom_masks compares a signed int loop index against std::vector::size(), producing sign-compare warnings in every one of its seven loops.
evidence: src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:2976, 2982, 2988, 2994, 3000, 3006, 3012 all read `for (int i = 0; i < default_xxx.size(); i++)` where default_xxx is a `const std::vector<std::string>` (src/atom_vec.cpp:33-41).  set_size_exchange has the same pattern at line 3023.
failure_scenario: No runtime defect; -Wsign-compare noise that can hide real warnings during the release build.
suggested_fix: Use `std::size_t i` (or a range-for over the vector) in these loops.
